verdict.rationale: Ashby documents its own HRIS integration: an API-based, bi-directional sync with Workday, plus 250+ integrations that include post-hire tools. That is direct product support for carrying hire data into an HRIS, but the evidence never says a signed offer triggers the handoff or which new-hire fields transfer. Webhooks and API endpoints are developer building blocks and get no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit offer-signed-to-onboarding trigger, payroll integration evidence, documented field mapping showing no re-entry, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, a signed offer flows into onboarding — HRIS and payroll integrations carry the new hire's data over without re-entry

citations.quote: Ashby's integration with Workday is API-based to allow for a flexible, bi-directional sync.
250+ out-of-the-box integrations into the platform, assessment, job boards, sourcing, interviewing, and post-hire tools you want to use.
